g.text: VBAT_ADC = VBAT / 2, max ~2.15 V incl. tolerances.

g.desc: VBAT_ADC = VBAT / 2, max ~2.15 V incl. tolerances.

g.text: ADC1 GPIO0: use calibrated 11/12 dB attenuation.

g.desc: ADC1 GPIO0: use calibrated 11/12 dB attenuation.

g.text: Divider load ~4.5 uA; allow >=120 ms to settle.

g.desc: Divider load ~4.5 uA; allow >=120 ms to settle.

g.text: USB_PRESENT_N: GPIO1 LOW when VBUS is present.

g.desc: USB_PRESENT_N: GPIO1 LOW when VBUS is present.

g.text: Firmware must disable USB attach when VBUS is absent.

g.desc: Firmware must disable USB attach when VBUS is absent.

g.text: Q2 isolates 5 V VBUS from the 3.3 V GPIO supply.

g.desc: Q2 isolates 5 V VBUS from the 3.3 V GPIO supply.

g.text: USB PROTOTYPE: dedicated 5 V / >=1.5 A source.

g.desc: USB PROTOTYPE: dedicated 5 V / >=1.5 A source.

g.text: Battery runtime and low-battery changes deferred.

g.desc: Battery runtime and low-battery changes deferred.

g.text: Test inrush, load steps and diode temperature.

g.desc: Test inrush, load steps and diode temperature.

g.text: 500 mA rail design target; validate transients.

g.desc: 500 mA rail design target; validate transients.

g.text: Buck only: low battery causes dropout / reset.

g.desc: Buck only: low battery causes dropout / reset.

g.text: Hold BOOT; tap RESET to enter ROM download mode.

g.desc: Hold BOOT; tap RESET to enter ROM download mode.

g.text: GPIO8 must stay high while GPIO9 is low.

g.desc: GPIO8 must stay high while GPIO9 is low.

g.text: 3.08 V supervisor, open-drain reset, ~200 ms delay.

g.desc: 3.08 V supervisor, open-drain reset, ~200 ms delay.

g.text: OPTIONAL battery test; USB works with J2 empty.

g.desc: OPTIONAL battery test; USB works with J2 empty.

g.text: J2: JST-PH 2.0mm; pin 1 = BAT+; pin 2 = GND.

g.desc: J2: JST-PH 2.0mm; pin 1 = BAT+; pin 2 = GND.

g.text: Battery performance deferred; check polarity before use.

g.desc: Battery performance deferred; check polarity before use.

g.text: USB D- = GPIO18; D+ = GPIO19. Native USB.

g.desc: USB D- = GPIO18; D+ = GPIO19. Native USB.

g.text: I2C: GPIO4 SDA / GPIO5 SCL; use 100 kHz.

g.desc: I2C: GPIO4 SDA / GPIO5 SCL; use 100 kHz.

g.text: GPIO6 NFC IRQ; GPIO7 VEN; GPIO3 OLED power.

g.desc: GPIO6 NFC IRQ; GPIO7 VEN; GPIO3 OLED power.

g.text: GPIO10 OLED reset; GPIO20 keyboard interrupt.

g.desc: GPIO10 OLED reset; GPIO20 keyboard interrupt.

g.text: GPIO21 is reserved; straps GPIO2/8/9 unchanged.

g.desc: GPIO21 is reserved; straps GPIO2/8/9 unchanged.

g.text: NUCULA v2 / USB-C, Li-ion power and ESP32-C3

g.desc: NUCULA v2 / USB-C, Li-ion power and ESP32-C3

g.text: CC1 / CC2: independent 5.1k Rd. No USB-PD.

g.desc: CC1 / CC2: independent 5.1k Rd. No USB-PD.

g.text: Route D+/D- as a 90 ohm differential pair.

g.desc: Route D+/D- as a 90 ohm differential pair.

g.text: Place U4 at connector; R12/R13 at module.

g.desc: Place U4 at connector; R12/R13 at module.

g.text: Prototype source: 5 V USB-C, at least 1.5 A.

g.desc: Prototype source: 5 V USB-C, at least 1.5 A.

g.text: Approx. 1.10 A planning budget; test startup/inrush.

g.desc: Approx. 1.10 A planning budget; test startup/inrush.
